title: Splitting over the punctured fixed formal test
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor with a rational point above $s_\eta$. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. Assume $\operatorname{depth}(\mathcal O_{S,s})\geq 2$ [def-weil-pbc-depth] and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. Fix $d\geq0$, $T=\operatorname{Spec}(A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]])$ with $A=\mathcal O_{S,s}$, and a flat map $t:T\to L$. Let $b:T\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be induced by the coefficient inclusion and $z:\operatorname{Spec}A\to T$ by evaluation at zero. Assume $t$ followed by the local-base projection is $b$, and $z$ followed by $t$ is the entire local section $\tau$. Put T equal to the fixed power-series test, F=(N×_C L)×_L T with projection r, E=∐_G T with projection p, and V the inverse image of C_U under T→L→C. There is an isomorphism e:(p inverse image V)→(r inverse image V) whose composite with r restricted to V equals p restricted to V. This asserts a splitting only over the punctured open V, not over T.

proof.text: Apply the proved punctured normalization restriction theorem to obtain finite etale p and r on V and the punctured zero-slice condition.

Apply the proved upstream GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_formal_zero_slice_split (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.StalkNormalizationFormalZeroSliceSplit) to get the isomorphism over V_0, with its base equation. Its hypotheses omit the unneeded hs and hmin, so the application uses s directly followed by d and t, as in the current upstream proof. The cited node is retained and now attaches to that theorem.

If d=0, the constant-coefficient ring map is the underlying map of MvPowerSeries.isEmptyEquiv; its Spec map and restriction to V are isomorphisms. If d>0, the original fully faithful punctured-section theorem gives bijections on every finite etale hom set. In either case apply the proved assembly theorem to lift the zero-slice isomorphism to an isomorphism over V in the required orientation.

theorem GaloisCover.exists_stalk_normalization_formal_punctured_split {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) (hZ : ∃ z : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
      (R := S.presheaf.stalk s) (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ (d : ℕ)
      (t : Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (S.presheaf.stalk s))) ⟶ pullback c a),
      Flat t →
      t ≫ pullback.snd c a =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin d))) →
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d))) ≫ t = τ →
      let T := Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (S.presheaf.stalk s)))
      let F : Scheme.{u} := pullback n t
      let E : Scheme.{u} := ∐ (fun _ : G ↦ T)
      let V := (t ≫ pullback.fst c a) ⁻¹ᵁ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      let r : F ⟶ T := pullback.snd n t
      let p : E ⟶ T := Sigma.desc (fun _ : G ↦ 𝟙 T)
      ∃ e : (p ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ r ∣_ V = p ∣_ V
